about.title: Agoura Hills Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Agoura Hills sees its share of car accidents along busy stretches like Kanan Road, the Ventura Freeway (US-101), Agoura Road, and Reyes Adobe Road, with crash reports often clustering on Friday afternoons as commuter and weekend traffic mix. Whether you were rear-ended near a freeway on-ramp or sideswiped at a local intersection, the aftermath can be disorienting — medical visits, insurance calls, missed work. LawProactive is not a law firm; we're a free service that connects injured people in Agoura Hills with independent personal injury attorneys who work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover money for you. An attorney in our network can help you understand your options, deal with insurance adjusters, and work to preserve evidence from the scene before it disappears. You focus on healing — we help you find the right legal help to handle the rest, without any upfront cost or obligation.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Settle

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of a car accident to file a personal injury claim in California, though claims against a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Missing these deadlines can mean losing your right to recover, so it helps to talk to someone early.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning your compensation can be reduced by the percentage of fault assigned to you — even if that's just 10% or 20%. An independent attorney can help make sure the insurance company isn't overstating your share of the blame.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California doesn't limit how much you can recover for pain, suffering, or emotional distress in a typical car accident case. That makes it especially important not to accept a quick settlement offer before understanding the full value of your claim.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Kanan Road or near the 101 in Agoura Hills?
items.answer: High-traffic corridors like Kanan Road and the Ventura Freeway see a steady number of reported collisions each year, and evidence like traffic camera footage or skid marks can disappear quickly. Acting fast to document the scene and preserve evidence can make a real difference in a claim.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.
